verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows building blocks. Per-seller balances can be retrieved via the API while authenticated as the connected account (docs-18), and webhooks deliver Connect events (docs-15). Neither amounts to settlement or reconciliation reporting. Missing for 10: settlement/reconciliation report files, platform-level rolled-up reports, scheduled report delivery to a finance stack, and payout-to-transaction reconciliation data. There is also no independent or hands-on corroboration.
